{{Top|leg}}
A '''resort satellite''' was the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that served as a vacation spot. One famous example was [[Hesperidium/Legends|Hesperidium]], a moon of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Gilatter VIII]] also had a [[Gilatter VIII resort satellite|notable resort satellite]].
